args.question: Could you please clarify what is meant by the "Facility with Potential Engagement-Outcome Disconnect" classification and which scores are relevant?

tool_trajectory.result: The "Facility with Potential Engagement-Outcome Disconnect" refers to facilities that show a high average Therapy Engagement Score (TES) but a low Recovery Trajectory Index (RTI). The relevant scores are the average TES and the RTI, both rounded to 2 decimal places.

args.sql:
SELECT 
    f.fackey AS facility_id, 
    AVG(td.engagement) AS avg_tes, 
    AVG(to.funcimpv) AS rti
FROM 
    facilities f
JOIN 
    clinicians c ON f.fackey = c.facconnect
JOIN 
    patients p ON c.clinkey = p.clinleadref
JOIN 
    assessmentbasics a ON p.patkey = a.patownerref
JOIN 
    assessmentsymptomsandrisk asr ON a.abkey = asr.asrkey
JOIN 
    treatmentbasics tb ON p.patkey = tb.encref
JOIN 
    treatmentoutcomes to ON tb.txkey = to.txref
JOIN 
    encounters e ON p.patkey = e.patref
JOIN 
    treatmentbasics tb ON e.enckey = tb.encref
JOIN 
    treatmentoutcomes to ON tb.txkey = to.txref
JOIN 
    jsonb_to_record(tb.therapy_details) td ON TRUE
GROUP BY 
    f.fackey
HAVING 
    AVG(td.engagement) > 0.8 AND AVG(to.funcimpv) < 0.2
ORDER BY 
    avg_tes DESC, rti ASC
LIMIT 10;
